caption: The drawing features a single object—a standing female nude sculpture rendered to appear as if it is carved from wood. The figure is depicted in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. It stands upright on a small, rectangular base. The woman's arms are relaxed at her sides, and her facial features and hair are outlined clearly, with the hair falling over her shoulders. The surface of the sculpture is textured and shaded to give the appearance of wood grain, with different shades of brown used for depth and highlights, and white accents to simulate reflected light on the polished surface. The sculpture is centrally positioned on a plain, light beige or tan background with a thin, rectangular border drawn around the edge of the page. There are no additional objects or decorative elements in the composition.
title: Carved Nude
